_notes: Register: du throughout, including the University console (no 'ni'/'er'). Agency copy is short and imperative; University copy is formal and analytical, and loose paraphrases were brought back to the English meaning (v28.pipe.*, stageHint.*, kpi.insufficientDetail).

638 missing strings translated. Glossary terms are shared with marketing-common: konsultation (stage.counselling, v27.stage.CONSULT were 'Rådgivning'), antagningsbrev / standardantagningsbrev, erbjudande (offer), bestyrkande av notarius publicus, apostille, konsulär legalisering, tilläggstjänst (add-on), tjänsteperiod (service period), studentboende (dormitory).

Status = 'Status' (was 'Läge'); student = 'Student' in agency (was mixed with 'Studerande'); nationality = 'Medborgarskap' in both consoles (university had 'Nationalitet'); message thread/conversation = 'konversation' ('samtal' reads as a phone call).

Deadlines: a university's closing date = 'sista ansökningsdag'; a mixed deadline list in Agency = 'tidsfrist(er)'; a task due date = 'senast {{date}}' / 'förfallodatum'. Caseload = 'dina studenter' / 'portfölj'; pipeline = 'studenter per skede'; Hangyul HQ = 'Hangyuls huvudkontor'; Insights = 'Insikter'.

Withdrawn = 'återtagen/återtagna' (was 'tillbakadragna'); not admitted = 'inte antagna', never 'avslag' as a status. 'Yield' keeps the English KPI term plus an explanation in brackets: owner may prefer a pure Swedish label.
Placeholder-only and identical strings (apps.actor.HANGYUL, ws.gpa, ws.tab.portfolio, kpi.sample, today.v5.*Detail) need --allow-same.
